definitions.explanation: A small, narrow vase designed to hold a single flower or a small branch. A traditional element of Japanese interior decoration, reflecting the aesthetic of appreciating beauty in simplicity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一輪挿|いちりんざ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I placed a bud vase in the entryway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一輪|いちりん}→一輪：24283_ichirin⟧⟦{摘|つ}んで→摘む：02472_tsumu⟧、{一輪挿|いちりんざ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}けた→生ける：10667_ikeru⟧。
examples.english: I picked a single flower from the garden and arranged it in a bud vase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{陶芸|とうげい}→陶芸：04449_tougei⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{一輪挿|いちりんざ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put seasonal flowers in a bud vase I made at pottery class and keep it on the dining table.

notes:
USAGE:
A traditional Japanese decorative item often made of ceramic, glass, bamboo, or metal. Embodies the wabi-sabi aesthetic of finding beauty in simplicity. Popular as a handmade gift from pottery classes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一輪挿|いちりんざ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}け→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧る (to arrange a flower in a bud vase)
- {一輪挿|いちりんざ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to display a bud vase)
- ⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一輪挿|いちりんざ}し (glass bud vase)
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一輪挿|いちりんざ}し (bamboo bud vase)
